details:
Description

Within the Drone Settings Camera Menu:

1. The custom camera zoom tune is not retained after the game closes, but does persist through worlds and drone closes.

2. The custom UI Mask toggles do retain after the game closes, but does persist through worlds and drone closes.

3. The "Flight Presets" lower scroll slider has a dead zone under it that resets the scroll if the mouse cursor is moved outside the sliders UI.

Reproduction Steps

(see 1) 1. In the drone camera menu: Zoom in or out. Anything that is not the default is not saved after the game closes.

(see 2) 2. In the drone camera menu: Select/toggle different UI Masks. Anything that is not the default is not saved after the game closes. 

(see 3) 3. In the drone camera menu: Select Flight Presets. Click and hold the horizontal scroll slider under the tunes. Slide in the desired direction to scroll, and during movement, if the cursor falls under the sliders UI, the scroll will reset despite picking back up if the cursor movement continues even lower than the dead zone.

Details

- Category: User Interface

- Frequency: Always
